CampusFlow / Page-by-page web redesign / 15 September 2026

Four pages.
Four distinct purposes.

The first individually redesigned student discovery pages: rooms, room details, events and announcements. These are screenshots of the implemented application—not design mockups.

4 of 31 signed-in pages in this expanded pass320 / 768 / 1440 px checkedLanding protected
The full all-role pass is still in progress. Remaining student/shared pages and staff/admin pages are tracked separately. Previous bespoke dashboards and login are retained, not counted as new work here.

Landing source hashes are unchanged and the current cold/client-navigation comparison has zero differing pixel channels.
